ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of low-intensity black pixels (central and peduncle region) to high-intensity white pixels (lateral lobe regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments on both lateral lobes. The central region is a solid dark mass with feathered transitions. The right lobe contains high-frequency dark speckling/mottling across the white field. The left lobe contains diagonal dark linear striations on the lower white section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex; estimated interior pixel angle between 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks are visible at the distal tips. Continuous micro-oscillations in pixel height against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark circular pixel clusters on the right white lobe. Dense, irregular high-contrast clusters (barnacle colonies) are located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, dark linear disruptions visible on the white field of the lower-left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization visible as textured, brownish-grey clusters at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity specular reflections (glare) on the right lobe surface caused by surface water and direct solar angle.
